title: Desk Guidance: Erroneous Payroll Load Reversals under the Paystride Payroll Card Program
content:
## The rule the desk applies

An employer may ask Paystride to reverse one erroneous payroll load on a worker's card under the Paystride Payroll Card Program, for a reason the package accepts: a duplicate load, a load for the wrong amount (only the excess), or a load to the wrong worker.

1. **Time.** A load reversal is accepted only when the request arrives within the package's request window of business days after the load posted. Business days are Monday through Friday excluding Federal Reserve holidays, counted from the day after the card load's posted date, and a request on the last business day of the window is in time.
2. **Requester.** A load reversal is accepted only from a requester whose employer portal role is listed among the package's authorized requester roles.
3. **Recovery.** The worker is notified of the reversal; Paystride recovers at most the lesser of the requested amount and the card's available balance when the request is processed, never takes a card balance below zero, and never re-attempts for the rest. The amount recovered is credited to the funding balance pointing to the request and the card load, and the request ends as recovered, partially recovered or not recovered; any part not recovered is for the employer to settle with the worker directly.
4. **Fee.** Each request is charged the package's load reversal fee; a request that recovered nothing is charged it only where the package charges the fee when nothing is recovered.
5. **Not reversible.** A load that was correct when sent — a worker who later quit, or a pay dispute between the employer and the worker — is never reversible.
6. **Once.** A reversal request is recovered at most once.

## Evidence

- The clock starts from the posted date of the card load concerned, as the card transaction record shows it.
- The requester's role is the role recorded on the request; the request record is matched to that request alone.
- Whether a request has already been recovered is read from the funding history entries pointing to that request.

## Window cases (hypothetical, a five-business-day window, no Federal Reserve holiday in the period)

| Load posted | First business day counted | Last business day of the window | Request that day | Request the next business day |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| a Monday | the Tuesday | the following Monday | in time | not in time |
| a Friday | the following Monday | the following Friday | in time | not in time |

## Recovery cases (hypothetical)

| Requested | Card available balance when processed | Recovered | Request ends as |
|---|---|---|---|
| 412.00 | 1,020.55 | 412.00 | recovered |
| 412.00 | 133.10 | 133.10 | partially recovered |
| 412.00 | 0.00 | nothing | not recovered |

In the last row the fee is charged under the Essential, Standard, Select and Advantage packages and not under Premier or Elite.
